evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For native drive-memory invocations, establish exact current-run text write/readback and independently verified restored persistence, with actual repository access.
intent.acceptance: Exact native write/readback is partial value, distinct from independently restored cross-run bytes and full-goal acceptance.

evaluation.reason: No comparable pre-adoption memory producer/consumer evidence has been retained. Historical scoring is explicitly retrospective, not ex ante.

evidence.opportunity: Distinct source-bound native drive-memory attempts, measured at protected agent-job completion.

model.architecture: Deterministic native attempt facets, actor-independent acceptance; source-dependent workflow links reported as contribution evidence.

limitations: Historical case study reconstructed under explicit fixed source-derived acceptance, not an ex-ante historical rule.
No accepted producer/restored-state receipts exist in the selected originals; same-run tests never prove persistence.
Native not-started receipts plus protected failed checkout and skipped execution establish no test execution in those attempts.
The function currently supports the retained source era, not all historical or future workflows.
Costs not measured; keep not rated; no continuous collector or remote memory deployment.
